name: Pratapgarh
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha service identifies district 173 Pratapgarh, tehsil 00882 Pratapgarh, and exposes official village-level cadastral-map lookup routes. The Government of Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh dashboard separately reports Pratapgarh tehsil cadastral-map digitization and linked Bhunaksha villages. This establishes a relevant state/district registry and map custodian, but not an open parcel response for this city.

runtimeAssessment.reason: The current official BhuNaksha JavaScript/configuration and anonymous endpoints were inspected, but both city-named village records were marked hasData=false. The city map extent returned zeros, and exact-point and plot-number requests returned empty objects. No stable native parcel identity plus full polygon was obtained; this is not treated as evidence of citywide absence.

requests.summary: Current Angular viewer HTML and JavaScript bundle retrieved with normal TLS verification; the bundle exposed the public map and plot routes.
Returned the public hierarchy labels District, Tehsil, Village.
Returned public Uttar Pradesh district codes, including 173 Pratapgarh.
Returned village records including 158800 प्रतापगढ़ सिटी (अ०) and 216228 प्रतापगढ़ सिटी बाहर; both records were marked extraParams.hasData=false.
Returned gisCode 17300882158800 and attribution for Pratapgarh city, but xmin, ymin, xmax and ymax were all 0.0.
Returned an empty JSON object; coordinate order was not changed and the result was not interpreted as absence.
Returned an empty JSON object; no geometry or native parcel identity was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha public viewer, Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh cadastral digitization dashboard, state Bhulekh portal and Pratapgarh district administration sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official district/tehsil/village hierarchy, public service routes, city-named village records and a bounded anonymous extent/plot response; no usable city parcel geometry, native ID, schema or CRS response.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or survey identifier if exposed
remainingUncertainty: The official service may have no digitized map for the city-named village records, may require a different administrative/village selection, or may expose geometry only through an unavailable map-data path. The zero extent and empty plot responses do not establish citywide absence.
nextStep: A serial reviewer may independently test a different officially listed Pratapgarh urban/revenue-village code if one is identified, and qualify an adapter only after a bounded anonymous response contains a stable native parcel identity and full polygon.
